A quick roundup of all the most important spaceflight news for the last couple of weeks. SpaceX is ready to launch Starship again, China has demonstrated it can recover rocket boosters, and NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman heads to Kazakhstan to watch Anil Menon launch to space.
